title: The Mandatory Testing and Disclosure (Bodily Substances) Amendment Act, 2026
resumeExecutif: Modifie les règles entourant les ordonnances de test obligatoire de substances corporelles, y compris pour les personnes décédées.
resumeExecutifEn: Amends Saskatchewan's law on mandatory testing of bodily substances to expand when and how testing orders can be made, including for deceased individuals.
titleEn: The Mandatory Testing and Disclosure (Bodily Substances) Amendment Act, 2026

title: The Statute Law Amendment Act, 2026
resumeExecutif: Corrige des erreurs de rédaction et modernise le langage dans plus de 20 lois de la Saskatchewan, sans changer les règles de fond.
resumeExecutifEn: Makes minor technical corrections to many Saskatchewan statutes, mainly replacing gendered pronouns with neutral wording and fixing outdated references.

title: The Municipal Employees' Pension Amendment Act, 2026
resumeExecutif: Modifie The Municipal Employees' Pension Act pour remplacer plusieurs règles fixées par la loi sur les rentes par des règles établies par règlement.
resumeExecutifEn: Amends the pension act to move rules for calculating certain retirement allowances from the Act itself into regulations set by the Lieutenant Governor in Council.
titleEn: The Municipal Employees' Pension Amendment Act, 2026

title: The Revenue and Financial Services Amendment Act, 2026
resumeExecutif: Modifie les règles de cotisation, d'appel et de recouvrement des taxes en Saskatchewan, dont les délais et les pouvoirs du ministre.
resumeExecutifEn: Amends Saskatchewan's tax collection and enforcement rules, including assessment time limits, penalty reinstatement, and collection procedures.
titleEn: The Revenue and Financial Services Amendment Act, 2026
